items.t: Piper Sandler Reiterates Overweight on Biogen, Raises Price Target to $305
items.sum: Piper Sandler analyst David Amsellem reiterates Biogen (NASDAQ:BIIB) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $245 to $305.

items.t: LEQEMBI® Pen (Subcutaneous Formulation of LEQEMBI®) Now Available in Japan for Patients with Early Alzheimer’s Disease
items.sum: The First and Only Anti-Amyloid Treatment in Japan that Enables At-Home AdministrationTOKYO and CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Eisai Co., Ltd. and Biogen Inc. (Nasdaq: BIIB) announced today that “LEQEMBI® Pen”, the subcutaneous (SC) formulation of “LEQEMBI®” (generic name: lecanemab) has been launched in Japan. LEQEMBI Pen was approved as a new route of administration in Japan
